name: models
description: Local model catalog and install manager: searches provider catalogs, records capabilities, and installs models into a user-scoped store. Local state lives at the effective models data home (~/.hasna/models by default, resolved via @hasna/paths; the XDG data home is adopted only once the store is migrated there or HASNA_DATA_HOME is set).

waivedStorageEngines.reason: models is a single-operator local CLI whose catalog and install state are user-scoped; it ships no serve bin and no hasna-saas story, so there is no multi-tenant deployment that would require PostgreSQL.
